how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-gnomeregan-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:2841:obj:0: Retrieve the Rig Blueprints and Thermaplugg's Safe Combination from Gnomeregan and bring them to Nogg in ⟦E1⟧.⟦1⟧
rows.quest:2841:details:0: Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, ⟦2⟧!
rows.quest:2841:details:1: BUnfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
rows.quest:2841:details:2: BDo whatever you have to do to get that combination, ⟦3⟧. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!⟦4⟧
rows.quest:2841:completion:0: I knew you could do it, ⟦5⟧! Sovik on the other hand, he had his doubts.
rows.quest:2841:completion:2: BNow that we have the blueprints in our possession, it is only a matter of time before we figure out all of the gnomish innovations that went into the creation of the rig and make them goblin innovations for our new shredder models.
rows.quest:2842:obj:0: Speak with Scooty in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:2842:details:0: As soon as we got word from Kernobee about the new gnomish rig, Scooty and I began work on the Transpolyporter 6000: The fastest and most reliable way to Gnomeregan.
rows.quest:2842:details:1: BIt's finally ready for passengers to board, ⟦7⟧. If you want to give it a try, go to Booty Bay and talk with Scooty at the wind rider roost. To get to Booty Bay, take the boat from Ratchet.
rows.quest:2842:details:2: BOf course, you could always try and make the run to Gnomeregan through the dwarf infested mountains of ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:2842:completion:0: She's a beauty, isn't she? Pinnacle of goblin transport technology -- only exploded a dozen or so times.
rows.quest:2842:completion:1: BDon't worry, ⟦8⟧, I've got her all fixed up. She won't blow up on you - and if she does, it'll be quick and painless.
rows.quest:2843:obj:0: Wait for Scooty to calibrate the Goblin Transponder.
rows.quest:2843:details:0: As long as you have the transponder in your possession, all you need to do is step on the pad and you'll be teleported to Gnomeregan.
rows.quest:2843:details:1: BYou may experience some unusual side effects, but none of those should be permanent... anymore.
rows.quest:2843:details:2: BI almost forgot the most important part - getting back. When you're ready to come back, just step on the transpolyporter pad in Gnomeregan!
rows.quest:2843:details:3: BNow to calibrate the transponder to your size and weight.⟦9⟧
rows.quest:2843:completion:0: All done! When you're ready, just step on the pad.
rows.quest:2904:obj:0: Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:2904:details:1: BThe last thing I remember is being captured by a group of dark iron dwarves, beaten to within an inch of my life and then thrown in here with these filthy troggs.
rows.quest:2904:details:3: BHere's the plan: Lead me to the exit; if we make it out alive, you go to Booty Bay and let Scooty know that I went to Ratchet to warn Tinkerwiz of the dark iron's involvement in the making of that super rig.
rows.quest:2904:completion:0: I suppose you should be rewarded for bringing Kernobee back to us in one piece, ⟦12⟧. If you go back to Gnomeregan, these might give you the edge you'll need in defeating that good-for-nothing backstabber, Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
rows.quest:2922:obj:0: Bring Techbot's Memory Core to Tinkmaster Overspark in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2922:details:0: When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue ⟦E4⟧ must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot. It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized. Now it's negatronic... and Techbot's behaviors are reversed. It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!
rows.quest:2922:details:1: BBut perhaps it can be salvaged. Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.
rows.quest:2922:completion:0: Oh, this is wonderful! Thank you, ⟦13⟧! I'll get to work immediately!!
rows.quest:2922:completion:1: BPoor, poor Techbot... Don't feel bad. We'll get you fixed.
rows.quest:2922:completion:2: BNow, where did I put that plug for my hydro-jack swivel spanner...
rows.quest:2923:details:0: Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot. I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.
rows.quest:2923:details:1: BVery sad. But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!
rows.quest:2923:details:2: BSpeak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in ⟦E3⟧. He would welcome your help.
rows.quest:2923:completion:0: Yes it's true. Techbot has gone rogue! Please, can you help me?
rows.quest:2924:obj:0: Bring 12 Essential Artificials to Klockmort Spannerspan in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2924:details:0: A nigh-universal mechanical component--the essential artificial--was of great use to the tinkers and smiths of Gnomeregan. But during the frantic exodus from our city, no one remembered to take any of these devices with them! And I need a large supply of them for work I will soon undertake.
rows.quest:2924:details:1: BPlease, go into Gnomeregan and get me some essential artificials. You'll find them in the deeper areas of our city, held in containers called artificial extrapolators.
rows.quest:2924:completion:0: You got them! Now I can begin my new experiments!
rows.quest:2924:completion:1: BI can't thank you enough, ⟦15⟧! Your bravery has advanced gnomish research by a leap and a bound!
rows.quest:2925:details:0: A gnome friend, Klockmort Spannerspan, sent word to me from ⟦E3⟧. He tells me he needs help on a dangerous, but essential, mission into Gnomeregan, the once great gnome city now contaminated and filled with mad gnomes and their devices.
rows.quest:2925:details:1: BI must stay here, but my heart aches to help my friend. If you can go in my stead, then I would be much indebted to you.
rows.quest:2925:details:2: BYou may find Klockmort in Tinkertown, in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2925:completion:0: I do! I do need help with a mission into Gnomeregan. And you're just the ⟦16⟧ to do it!
rows.quest:2926:obj:0: Use the Empty Leaden Collection Phial on Irradiated Invaders or Irradiated Pillagers to collect radioactive fallout. Once it is full, take it back to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.
rows.quest:2926:details:0: Since the accident, all Gnoarn thinks about or talks about is cleansing Gnomeregan of the trogg infestation and finding a cure for the sickness that plagues it, ⟦17⟧.
rows.quest:2926:details:1: BLuckily, Razzle and I are close to some kind of cure - either that or the recipe for a really powerful rum. We won't know until we test! Naturally, in order to test our theory, we're going to need a few things; namely, fallout from the irradiated troggs in Gnomeregan. Fill up this phial with the green glow and bring it back!
rows.quest:2926:completion:0: Excellent work! The time has come to test the new formula. If this works, not only should that captured leper gnome be cured, but I should have a full head of hair! Stand back!
rows.quest:2927:obj:0: Speak with Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.
rows.quest:2927:details:0: You don't think I was always bald, do you? No ⟦18⟧! It was the radiation leak in Gnomeregan that caused this tragic hair loss. Before that day, I had the only gnomefro in all of ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:2927:details:1: B<Gnoarn shakes his fist in the air.>
rows.quest:2927:details:2: BDamn those damned dirty troggs - damn them all!!
rows.quest:2927:details:3: BPerhaps it's not too late, ⟦19⟧. We may still be able to save it - the city I mean! Speak to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. He and his partner Razzle are working on a solution.
rows.quest:2927:completion:0: I thought the loss of that outstanding head of hair would have been the end of him for sure, but he survived!
rows.quest:2927:completion:1: BI was standing right next to him when he was hit by the radiation bolt. Those delightful brown locks of hair hit the floor in clumps! Clusters! The horror of it all was only compounded when Gnoarn completely freaked out! Oh yes, freaked out I say! Gnoarn touched his bald head in disbelief, the look in his eyes screamed revenge, ⟦20⟧! Then he turned his anger towards the troggs!
rows.quest:2928:obj:0: Bring twenty-four Robo-mechanical Guts to Shoni in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2928:details:0: It's terrible, ⟦22⟧. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2928:details:1: BWhat we need are spare parts, ⟦23⟧. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.
rows.quest:2928:details:2: BWhat I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.⟦24⟧
rows.quest:2928:completion:0: This will do nicely, ⟦25⟧. One gyrodrillmatic excavationator fixed; 398 left to go.
rows.quest:2929:obj:0: Venture to Gnomeregan and kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque when the task is complete.
rows.quest:2929:details:0: I trusted Thermaplugg, ⟦26⟧. Never did I expect that he would betray me and the entire gnomish people. And for what? Power? Wealth? All things that he would have had in time. Now we have been displaced from our home and that madman is in charge. The king of nothing....
rows.quest:2929:details:1: BWe will retake Gnomeregan, ⟦27⟧. We will not stop until the city is back in our control. If you wish to join in our fight, a simple task I ask of you: Kill the betrayer. Destroy Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
rows.quest:2929:completion:0: I like to think that the last thing that went through his head as he collapsed to the ground was your foot, ⟦28⟧. With Thermaplugg dead, our plans to retake Gnomeregan are one step closer to becoming a reality.
rows.quest:2930:obj:0: Bring a Prismatic Punch Card to Master Mechanic Castpipe in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2930:details:0: When we fled Gnomeregan, we left so much data behind! Vitally important data!
rows.quest:2930:details:1: BI need the data on a prismatic punch card, from a Matrix Punchograph 3005-D high security terminal, deep in Gnomeregan. You must access the terminal, but to do that you first need clearance... and to get that you must access lower security terminals-- models -A, -B and -C. And to do THAT you need security punch cards, starting with white... and we left all the punch cards in the city.
rows.quest:2930:details:2: BIt's a catastrophe! Can you help?
rows.quest:2930:completion:0: You did it! You found the prismatic punch card and recovered the lost data! Vitally, critically, immeasurably important data that we could not live another moment without!
rows.quest:2930:completion:1: BYour service to the gnomes will be long remembered, ⟦29⟧.
rows.quest:2931:obj:0: Speak with Master Mechanic Castpipe in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2931:details:0: Master Mechanic Castpipe in ⟦E3⟧ has need of adventurers! He's organizing bands to reenter Gnomeregan on a data retrieval mission of top security and importance.
rows.quest:2931:details:1: BCastpipe might not be a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, ⟦E7⟧ and ⟦E8⟧ Sciences like I am, but he's still a smart gnome so if he thinks it's important, then by my calculations there's an eighty-four percent probability that it really is important!
rows.quest:2931:completion:0: I'm organizing data extraction missions into Gnomeregan. If you're here for that, then listen up!
rows.quest:2945:obj:0: Figure out a way to remove the grime from the Grime-Encrusted Ring.
rows.quest:2945:details:0: You have uncovered what appears to be a ring from the corpse of one of the Dark Iron dwarves. It is difficult to tell what kind of ring it is, however; dirt and hardened residue cake the item completely, making wearing it impossible. You think you can make out the slight luster of precious metal and maybe even the glint of a gem under the residue.
rows.quest:2945:details:1: BIf you are going to make use of this ring, you are going to need to find something to get the hardened residue off of it.
rows.quest:2945:completion:0: You place the ring inside the Sparklematic 5200 and deposit a silver coin into the slot.
rows.quest:2945:completion:1: BPainful grinding noises emanate from the machine as it begins to jerk around violently. One can only guess what is happening with the ring inside the machine...
rows.quest:2945:completion:2: BThe machine suddenly stops, trumpeting its cessation with a simple "Ding!" The item receptacle opens up to reveal a small box that is neatly wrapped with a red bow. It would appear that the Sparklematic 5200 also gift wraps!
rows.quest:2947:obj:0: You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.
rows.quest:2947:details:0: Opening the box produced by the Sparklematic 5200 reveals what you had suspected - a shiny ring! Wearing the ring, you feel magic power surge through you body.
rows.quest:2947:details:1: BInside the band is a small but nonetheless discernable imprint of the seal of ⟦E3⟧. Next to that, three small initials are engraved: "TdK". This may signify either the initials of the previous owner, or perhaps the initials of the ring's crafter. Keep the ring... or return it to this person. Decisions, decisions...
rows.quest:2947:completion:0: A ring, you say? Let's see... yep, I made that ring by golly.
rows.quest:2947:completion:1: BBefore Gnomeregan went up, I had a small shop there. Perhaps it's one I left behind when I ran for the hills; it's a simple design, and I made several like it. Maybe it's from someone who didn't make it out.
rows.quest:2947:completion:2: BDark Iron dwarves had this? Well, that puts a new layer of conspiracy on the nine different layers already floating about. Maybe the authorities would like to know; it's wasted on the likes of me.
rows.quest:2949:obj:0: You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.
rows.quest:2949:details:0: Opening the box produced by the Sparklematic 5200 reveals a shiny ring! Donning the ring, you feel magic power surge through your body.
rows.quest:2949:details:1: BInside the band is a small but nonetheless discernable imprint of the seal of ⟦E1⟧. Engraved letters are next to it, but only the first three stand out even after cleaning: "NOG..."
rows.quest:2949:details:2: BThis may signify either the initials of the previous owner, or perhaps the initials of the ring's crafter. Keep the ring... or find "NOG" - decisions, decisions...
rows.quest:2949:completion:0: A ring from Gnomeregan? Let's see... not mine, but interesting.
rows.quest:2949:completion:1: BThe Gnomeregan thing - couldn't have happened to a nicer bunch of numbskulls. For years they're a joke, and now almost overnight they're making better rigs than us?
rows.quest:2949:completion:2: BDark Iron dwarves had the ring? That's even more interesting! You know, maybe the gnomes stole their crazy golem plans and modified them. Those Dark Irons, they'd definitely want some major payback. It's certainly worth investigating.
rows.quest:2951:obj:0: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.
rows.quest:2951:details:0: This contraption stands out amongst the gnomes holding out against the madness outside the room. A small plaque on the device reads "The Sparklematic 5200", followed by some text:
rows.quest:2951:details:1: B"Grime and residue ruining your sparklies? The Sparklematic 5200 puts the shine back in shine-tastic! Insert the item you wish to clean and deposit three silver coins in the coin slot. Give the Sparklematic 5200 a moment for operation, and voila! Your valuables will emerge clean and shiny!"
rows.quest:2951:completion:0: You insert the grime-encrusted item and three silver coins into the Sparklematic 5200. The machine surges to life in a frenzied attempt to purge the grime from the unknown item. Loud, violent churning sounds beat from the heart of the machine. The metal frame of the beast creaks and groans as it lurches from side to side...
rows.quest:2952:completion:0: As quickly as it started, the Sparklematic 5200 comes to an abrupt halt. A simple "ding" is heard from the machine, and the mouth of the machine spirals upward. Inside the Sparklematic 5200 is a small box wrapped in a little bow. The machine would appear to wrap an object up after eliminating its grime-encrusted status. Even if the machine didn't work, at least the item is now wrapped in a pretty box.
rows.quest:2952:completion:1: BWell, there is one way to find out if it cleaned the item or not...
rows.quest:2962:obj:0: ⟦E9⟧ to Gnomeregan and bring back High Potency Radioactive Fallout. Be warned, the fallout is unstable and will collapse rather quickly.
rows.quest:2962:obj:1: BOzzie will also require your Heavy Leaden Collection Phial when the task is complete.⟦30⟧
rows.quest:2962:details:0: Not only was your sample insufficient in quantity, it was also impure.
rows.quest:2962:details:1: BWhat we require is more green glow. The troggs are obviously not irradiated sufficiently to fulfill our needs. You will have to go into Gnomeregan and bring back some radioactive fallout, straight from the tap. I am speaking of the irradiated slimes, lurkers and horrors. Be warned, the containment of this type of fallout is difficult. You may need to make several attempts with the phial until a suitable sampling is recovered.
rows.quest:2962:completion:0: ⟦31⟧ Impressive, you still have all of your limbs. Now it's time to see what this stuff can do!
